entry.title: Aon Center

Published 346.3 m architectural/362.5 m tip replace rounded map height tags. Roof antenna at native [8,-12] is a photograph estimate on the eastern side of the mapped roof plant, not an independently mapped location. Signed footprint/roof phase retained, ground Y=0, accepted plan2 m/1 degree; replacement disabled. Sunken two-level plaza, terrain slope and exact doors remain outside this tower shell. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
